name: Set Cells
description: Write a block of values from a start cell — a two-dimensional list, one inner list per row — a header line, a small table, a key-value panel. A text starting with '=' is a formula.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const ws = workbook.getWorksheet(sheet) || workbook.addWorksheet(sheet || 'Sheet1'); const from = ws.getCell(String(start || 'A1')); (Array.isArray(values) ? values : []).forEach((row, i) => (Array.isArray(row) ? row : [row]).forEach((v, j) => { const c = ws.getCell(from.row + i, from.col + j); c.value = typeof v === 'string' && v.startsWith('=') ? { formula: v.slice(1) } : v; })); return workbook; })() }}"}]
